items.text:
subject_definitions: <Picture 1> is the uploaded 效果 reference at order 1. <Subject 1> is the wet exterior brick wall and old vine in <Picture 1>, with wet red-brown brick seams, sparse vine branches, and olive-green leaf texture. <Picture 2> is the accepted opening frame for [Shot 1], fixing the approved starting composition, visible positions, and initial state for this shot.
summary: [keyframe completion + reference generation] The target video is a single vertical period-drama shot in the early-1900s New York artist-apartment world. A lantern and ladder enter the storm as the painting itself stays outside the viewer's sight. The opening is anchored by <Picture 2> and preserves <Subject 1>.
retention_analysis: <Picture 1> (reference image order 1): fully_preserved - its 效果 role is retained as the input reference for this shot. <Picture 2> (opening frame of [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - the supplied starting composition, visible placement, and initial state open the shot. <Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - wet red-brown brick seams, sparse vine branches, and olive-green leaf texture remain stable; the approved motion changes only the shot's stated action and endpoint.
detailed_description: The target video is a realistic live-action period drama in a vertical 9:16 frame, with restrained natural light, tactile period materials, and observational camera movement. The shot begins from <Picture 2>, with <Subject 1> filling the wet exterior wall and the final leaf held against the storm. At 0.00 to 2.00 seconds the wall is nearly swallowed by rain and the lower vine is visibly sparse. From 2.00 to 4.80 seconds a downstairs door opens at the edge of the exterior view; a warm lantern glow moves across the wet ground, followed by the scrape of a narrow wooden ladder dragged over stone. At 4.80 to 7.00 seconds the lantern glow passes out of frame and the rain curtain fills the wall again. The concrete painting activity stays beyond the camera's view. Use a high-angle slow pan that follows only the moving glow and ladder trace; one continuous take with no cut. No non-diegetic subtitles, captions, or dialogue text overlays appear at any moment. Continuity locks: narrow top-floor artist studio with a tall rain-streaked window and exposed brick; final olive-green leaf on a wet brown vine.
overall_soundscape: Violent rain, water rushing over stone, a metal lantern handle rattling, a wooden ladder scraping the ground, and one suppressed cough far below.
non_diegetic_music: N/A
